sing.title: Sing
sing.description: Buster Moon, an optimistic koala who owns a struggling theater, organizes a singing competition to save his business. A group of talented animals enters the contest, each hoping to change their lives through music.

sing2.title: Sing 2
sing2.description: Buster Moon and his talented performers set out to create a spectacular musical show in Redshore City. To make their dream come true, they must convince legendary rock star Clay Calloway to return to the stage.
